name: GasGas TXT trials
engine: 125 to 299 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke single, carb, premix
intro: GasGas trials bikes. Very light, no seat, premix and parts that wear from constant clutch use.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual.

recallNote: Off-road and trials models are often not in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a dealer for the make to run the frame number.
